resources.string: X-OmniClaw uses the accessibility service to (1) inspect the on-screen UI tree, (2) dispatch taps, swipes, and text input on your behalf, and (3) capture screenshots of the current screen as a vision fallback when the UI tree is not parseable. Screenshots may be sent to the third-party vision-language model (VLM) endpoint you configure in Settings (default: OpenRouter) so the agent can interpret complex UIs. Configure or disable the VLM in Settings → AI Provider at any time. The service does not upload accessibility tree content to any server except your configured LLM/VLM endpoint.
Runs the on-device agent loop in the background so long tasks can complete without the app staying open.
Agent is executing a task on your device.
X-OmniClaw is capturing the screen for vision fallback.
Push-to-talk bubble that overlays other apps.
X-OmniClaw needs the accessibility service to inspect the current UI and perform taps, swipes, and text entry. Without it, the agent can reason but cannot act.
Required to show the floating push-to-talk bubble on top of other apps.
Used by Omni Perception to capture real-world frames when you point the camera at an object.
Used for speech-to-action: your voice is transcribed and routed into the agent loop.
Required to keep the agent loop alive as a foreground service on Android 13+.
Required by gallery memory and the one-tap video skill to scan your local gallery.
